verdict: The biggest movement this period is CPL spiking +207.92% week-over-week, driven by Google Ads spend surging +169.2% (led by the LocalServicesCampaign at $1,437.17) while leads simultaneously dropped -38.46%, a classic sign of budget scaling outpacing conversion volume. Meta is carrying all 23 tracked leads at a $44.99 effective CPL on that channel, but Google's 6 conversions at $2,462.47 in spend signals the LSA campaign needs efficiency review before further scaling.

performance.verdict: Google spend doubled but leads fell; Meta alone is working; SOW launch still missing.

findings.text: 5 overdue SOW milestones (LSA verification, ads launch, site live, stack test, Meta retargeting) remain unresolved as of 2026-09-19 — 49+ days past July 31 deadline.
CPL spiked +207.92% WoW; Google spent $2,462.47 in 28 days for 6 conversions at ~$410 CPL vs Meta's 23 leads at $44.99 — Google efficiency is confirmed broken.
3-day signal (Sep 16–18): spend averaged $241/day but leads held at 1/day, same as prior 3 days (Sep 13–15: 1/day at $189/day) — volume flat while cost per day rose 27%.
GHL shows 99 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, and 251 contacts — no signed cases traceable; intake or pipeline is leaking, not an ads problem.
GBP actions dropped -51.22% WoW; last 3 days (Sep 16–18) show 0 GBP actions, down from 3–10/day earlier in the window — organic referral source going dark.

suggestions.text: Pause LocalServicesCampaign immediately — $1,437.17 spent, 6 conversions, ~$410 CPL vs Meta's $44.99 CPL over same 28-day window.
suggestions.monday_update: Pause the LocalServicesCampaign (SystemGenerated:000656b9a9b1ed48) which consumed $1,437.17 in 28 days and produced only 6 conversions at an implied ~$410 CPL. Meta is delivering 23 leads at $44.99 CPL in the same period — Google spend is confirmed inefficient for 14+ days. Success check: total CPL returns below $100 within 7 days as Meta carries full load. Re-evaluate Google relaunch only after SOW milestone F1 (LSA verification, proper conversion tracking) is cleared.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL intake leak: 99 opportunities, 0 won, 0 appointments — pipeline is not progressing any of the 251 contacts to signed cases.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 99 opportunities created and 251 contacts but 0 appointments booked and 0 cases won across the 28-day window. This is an intake process failure, not an ads problem. Nacer should audit the pipeline stage progression and confirm speed-to-lead (SOW target: first contact under 5 min) is being met. Success check: at least 1 appointment booked and confirmed in GHL within 7 days of fix. Re-check 2026-09-26.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: 0 actions for 3 consecutive days (Sep 16–18) after averaging 5–10/day earlier — confirm profile is not suppressed before acting.
